name: LINCS L1000 / CMap (2017 release)
modality_en: bulk L1000 profiles (978 landmark genes measured; other genes inferred, per MD03)
modality_zh: bulk L1000 谱（测量 978 个标志基因，其余基因为推断，依据 MD03）
scale_reported_en: 1,319,138 perturbational profiles in GEO series GSE92742 (DS03); 19,811 drug-like small molecules on about 70 human cell lines plus several thousand genetic perturbagens (DS04)
scale_reported_zh: GEO 系列 GSE92742 中的 1,319,138 个扰动谱（DS03）；约 70 个人类细胞系上的 19,811 种类药小分子，另有数千个遗传扰动剂（DS04）
perturbation_type_en: small molecules; genetic knockdown and overexpression (secondary, DS04)
perturbation_type_zh: 小分子；基因敲低和过表达（二手，DS04）
genotype_info_en: cell-line identity only; no donor genotype
genotype_info_zh: 仅有细胞系身份；没有供体基因型
dose_time_axes_en: variable concentrations and treatment times; the package default subset is 10 uM and 24 h (DS04)
dose_time_axes_zh: 浓度和处理时间可变；软件包默认子集为 10 uM 和 24 h（DS04）
relevance_en: B track: drug-response context across cell lines; in about 600 drug-cell-line pairs, cell-type specificity depended on drug class (GD41)
relevance_zh: B 轨道：跨细胞系的药物响应背景；在约 600 个药物–细胞系对中，细胞类型特异性取决于药物类别（GD41）
caveats_en: Compound and cell-line counts are the Bioconductor package authors' description (DS04), not the provider's.
caveats_zh: 化合物和细胞系的数目是 Bioconductor 软件包作者的描述（DS04），不是提供方的。

name: LINCS2 beta (secondary description)
scale_reported_en: more than 80k perturbations, more than 200 cell lines and over 3 million profiles, about a 3-fold expansion of LINCS 2017 (DS04)
scale_reported_zh: 超过 8 万（80k）次扰动、超过 200 个细胞系和超过 300 万个谱，约为 LINCS 2017 的 3 倍（DS04）
relevance_en: B track: possible larger successor to L1000
relevance_zh: B 轨道：L1000 可能更大的后继数据集
caveats_en: Beta release described by the package authors (DS04), who ship 136,460 exemplar signatures over 58 lines; verify at the provider.
caveats_zh: 测试版由软件包作者描述（DS04），他们提供覆盖 58 个细胞系的 136,460 个范例特征；需在提供方核实。

name: Tahoe-100M
scale_reported_en: 100,648,790 cells in the obs table, 95,624,334 labeled full; 50 cell lines (median 1,833,415 cells, minimum 18,340); 379 drugs at 3 doses give 1,137 drug-dose conditions plus DMSO; 14 plates of 96 wells (derived from the dataset metadata, DS07, Q137)
scale_reported_zh: obs 表中有 100,648,790 个细胞，其中 95,624,334 个标为 full；50 个细胞系（中位 1,833,415 个细胞，最少 18,340 个）；379 种药物 × 3 个剂量得到 1,137 个药物-剂量条件，另有 DMSO；14 块 96 孔板（推导自数据集元数据，DS07，Q137）
perturbation_type_zh: 多个剂量下的小分子药物
genotype_info_en: cell-line identity (Cellosaurus and DepMap IDs) with per-line driver annotation (gene, variant type, zygosity, effect); every line has at least one annotated driver; TP53 in 33, KRAS in 24, CDKN2A in 22 and BRAF in 9 of 50 lines (derived, DS07, Q137)
genotype_info_zh: 细胞系身份（Cellosaurus 和 DepMap ID）及逐系驱动突变注释（基因、变异类型、纯合性、效应）；每个细胞系至少有一个被注释的驱动突变；50 个系中 TP53 有 33 个、KRAS 有 24 个、CDKN2A 有 22 个、BRAF 有 9 个（推导，DS07，Q137）
dose_time_axes_en: dose: three levels, 0.05, 0.5 and 5 uM; time: not stated on the dataset card
dose_time_axes_zh: 剂量：三个水平，0.05、0.5 和 5 uM；时间：数据集卡片未说明
relevance_en: S track backbone: context-dependent drug response; cell-line identity, not batch, dominates clustering
relevance_zh: S 轨道骨干：依赖背景的药物响应；主导聚类的是细胞系身份而不是批次
caveats_en: Lung 15, bowel 9 and pancreas 7 of the 50 lines; in the 12 lineage-matched mutant-versus-other contrasts computed, the smaller arm holds 1 to 6 lines (TP53 in lung 12 versus 3; derived, DS07, Q137); 975 of 1,138 conditions are a single well; drug targets and mechanisms were assigned by a language model and checked against a vendor catalogue; CC0.
caveats_zh: 50 个系中肺 15 个、肠 9 个、胰腺 7 个；在已计算的 12 个按谱系匹配的突变株对其他株对比中，较小的一臂有 1 至 6 个系（肺中 TP53 为 12 对 3；推导，DS07，Q137）；1,138 个条件中有 975 个只有一个孔；药物靶点和作用机制由语言模型赋予并对照厂商目录核对；CC0。

name: Genome-scale Perturb-seq in primary human CD4+ T cells
scale_reported_en: about 22 million cells; 4 donors; all expressed genes perturbed; profiled at rest and after stimulation (DS08)
scale_reported_zh: 约 22 百万（2,200 万）个细胞；4 名供体；所有表达基因均被扰动；在静息和刺激后分别分析（DS08）
perturbation_type_en: genetic perturbation of all expressed genes
perturbation_type_zh: 对所有表达基因的遗传扰动
relevance_en: G/B track: donor-level variation could be probed, but no donor-by-perturbation analysis was seen in the excerpt
relevance_zh: G/B 轨道：可以探查供体层面的变异，但在摘录中未见供体×扰动的分析
caveats_en: Abstract-level source; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 来源仅为摘要层面；数据获取途径未核查。

name: Perturbation cell atlas of human iPSCs (KOLF2.1J)
scale_reported_en: 11,739 targeted genes in one hiPSC line (KOLF2.1J); cell count not retrieved (DS09)
scale_reported_zh: 一个 hiPSC 细胞系（KOLF2.1J）中 11,739 个被靶向的基因；细胞数未取得（DS09）
relevance_en: B track: baseline for iPSC Perturb-seq; one genotype, so it cannot test genotype dependence
relevance_zh: B 轨道：iPSC Perturb-seq 的基线；只有一个基因型，因此无法检验基因型依赖性
caveats_en: Preprint abstract level; cell count and data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 预印本摘要层面；细胞数和数据获取途径未核查。

name: Anthracycline response-QTL dataset (iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes)
scale_reported_en: 45 individuals; five doxorubicin concentrations for 24 h; response eQTLs for 376 genes from total expression (447 with allele-specific expression); 42 response sQTLs (GD06, DS13)
scale_reported_zh: 45 个个体；5 个阿霉素浓度、24 h；仅用总表达得到 376 个基因的响应 eQTL（加入等位基因特异表达后为 447 个）；42 个响应 sQTL（GD06、DS13）
genotype_info_en: genotyped Hutterite individuals (GD06); the Zenodo record lists expression for 217 samples and eQTL and splicing-QTL tables, but no genotype file (DS13)
genotype_info_zh: 做过基因分型的 Hutterite 个体（GD06）；Zenodo 记录列出 217 个样本的表达以及 eQTL 和剪接 QTL 表，但没有基因型文件（DS13）
dose_time_axes_en: dose: five doxorubicin concentrations; time: 24 h
dose_time_axes_zh: 剂量：5 个阿霉素浓度；时间：24 h
relevance_en: G track: positive control for response-QTL work; the only study retrieved that links in-vitro response to in-vivo cardiotoxicity risk
relevance_zh: G 轨道：响应 QTL 工作的阳性对照；检索到的唯一把体外响应与体内心脏毒性风险联系起来的研究
caveats_en: Only 45 individuals; CC0 record; genotype files are not listed.
caveats_zh: 只有 45 个个体；CC0 记录；没有列出基因型文件。

name: Hepatocyte response-QTL study (African American donors)
modality_zh: 基因表达（检测方法未取得）
scale_reported_en: 60 primary hepatocyte cultures from African American donors, baseline and 6 drugs; 2,988 response eQTLs (GD01)
scale_reported_zh: 来自非裔美国供体的 60 个原代肝细胞培养物，基线及 6 种药物；2,988 个响应 eQTL（GD01）
relevance_en: G track: drug-perturbed reQTLs; best-known example involves CYP3A5, a PK gene (judgment J8)
relevance_zh: G 轨道：药物扰动的 reQTL；最著名的例子涉及 PK 基因 CYP3A5（判断 J8）
caveats_en: Preprint abstract level; donor number and data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 预印本摘要层面；供体数和数据获取途径未核查。

name: Glucocorticoid-treated lymphoblastoid lines
scale_reported_en: 114 lymphoblastoid lines (57 YRI, 57 TSI), dexamethasone versus vehicle for 8 h; 4,568 differentially expressed genes; 26 genes with cis-eQTL-by-treatment interaction (GD08)
scale_reported_zh: 114 个淋巴母细胞系（57 个 YRI、57 个 TSI），地塞米松与溶媒对照 8 h；4,568 个差异表达基因；26 个基因存在 cis-eQTL×处理交互（GD08）
genotype_info_en: cell-line genotypes; YRI and TSI ancestry
genotype_info_zh: 细胞系基因型；YRI 和 TSI 祖源
dose_time_axes_zh: 地塞米松对溶媒；时间：8 h
relevance_en: G track: classic gene-by-treatment design
relevance_zh: G 轨道：经典的基因×处理设计
caveats_en: Published text read; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 已读正式发表的文本；数据获取途径未核查。

name: iPSC endoderm-differentiation sc-eQTL (125 lines)
scale_reported_en: 125 donor-derived lines pooled and genotype-demultiplexed; 4 time points; 36,044 cells; 899 time-dynamic eQTLs among 4,422 (GD18)
scale_reported_zh: 125 个来源于供体的细胞系混池并按基因型解复用；4 个时间点；36,044 个细胞；4,422 个 eQTL 中有 899 个随时间动态变化（GD18）
genotype_info_zh: 125 株来源于供体的细胞系
relevance_en: G track: shows dynamic genetic effects; contains no drug
relevance_zh: G 轨道：显示动态遗传效应；不含药物
caveats_en: Data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 数据获取途径未核查。

name: Geuvadis (lymphoblastoid RNA-seq plus whole-genome data)
scale_reported_en: 421 individuals (lymphoblastoid cell lines) (GV05)
scale_reported_zh: 421 个个体（淋巴母细胞系）（GV05）
genotype_info_en: individual-level genotypes (not checked in the sources read)
genotype_info_zh: 个体层面的基因型（所读来源未核对）
relevance_en: G track: benchmark for personal expression prediction by sequence models
relevance_zh: G 轨道：序列模型预测个体表达的基准
caveats_en: Access route not retrieved.
caveats_zh: 获取途径未取得。

name: GTEx v8
scale_reported_en: 838 genotyped donors, up to 15% non-European (EV25)
scale_reported_zh: 838 名做过基因分型的供体，最多 15% 为非欧洲人（EV25）
genotype_info_en: individual-level genotypes (not checked in the sources read)
genotype_info_zh: 个体层面的基因型（所读来源未核对）
relevance_en: G track: eQTL reference; ancestry bias; fine-mapped GTEx eQTLs were used to evaluate AlphaGenome
relevance_zh: G 轨道：eQTL 参考；存在祖源偏倚；精细定位的 GTEx eQTL 被用于评估 AlphaGenome
caveats_en: Access route not retrieved.
caveats_zh: 获取途径未取得。

name: OneK1K plus eQTLGen (single-cell eQTL atlas)
modality_zh: 单细胞 eQTL 加血液 eQTL
scale_reported_en: OneK1K 982 donors in 14 cell types; eQTLGen over 30,000 donors (GD15)
scale_reported_zh: OneK1K 有 982 名供体、14 种细胞类型；eQTLGen 有超过 30,000 名供体（GD15）
relevance_en: G track: cell-type-resolved eQTLs
relevance_zh: G 轨道：细胞类型分辨的 eQTL
caveats_en: The 586% gain is self-reported (GD15); data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 586% 的增益为自报（GD15）；数据获取途径未核查。

name: DepMap, GDSC and PRISM (cell-line omics and drug sensitivity)
modality_en: cell-line expression and mutation features plus drug sensitivity (viability)
modality_zh: 细胞系表达和突变特征加药物敏感性（活力）
scale_reported_en: GDSC 286 drugs on 686 lines; PRISM 6,337 drugs on 887 lines (EV17)
scale_reported_zh: GDSC 为 286 种药物 × 686 个系；PRISM 为 6,337 种药物 × 887 个系（EV17）
genotype_info_zh: 细胞系层面的突变特征
relevance_en: S track annotation backbone for mutation-by-drug questions
relevance_zh: S 轨道：突变×药物问题的注释骨干
caveats_en: Targets are viability and gene dependency, not transcriptomes; Pearson correlation on these data is bias-prone (EV15).
caveats_zh: 预测目标是活力和基因依赖性，而不是转录组；这些数据上的 Pearson 相关容易受偏倚影响（EV15）。

name: Virtual Cell Challenge 2026 CRISPRi cell-line datasets
scale_reported_en: six CRISPRi cell lines with identical sgRNAs, time point and platform; over 10,000 perturbations per line, median 500 cells each; curated to at least 80% median knockdown and subsampled to 400 cells per perturbation (EV09)
scale_reported_zh: 六个 CRISPRi 细胞系，sgRNA、时间点和平台相同；每个系超过 10,000 个扰动，每个扰动中位 500 个细胞；筛选为中位敲低至少 80%，并下采样到每个扰动 400 个细胞（EV09）
relevance_en: B track: zero-shot cross-context benchmark
relevance_zh: B 轨道：零样本跨背景基准
caveats_en: Design from EV09; EV07 is abstract level; the challenge dates were not verified.
caveats_zh: 设计来自 EV09；EV07 仅为摘要层面；挑战赛日期未核实。

name: Virtual Cell Challenge 2025 H1 hESC genetic-perturbation benchmark
scale_reported_en: 300 CRISPRi perturbations in H1 hESCs, about 300,000 cells (EV05)
scale_reported_zh: H1 hESC 中的 300 个 CRISPRi 扰动，约 300,000 个细胞（EV05）
relevance_en: B track: within-context benchmark used by Lingshu-Cell (self-reported lead)
relevance_zh: B 轨道：Lingshu-Cell 使用的情境内基准（自报领先）
caveats_en: Organizer report; models did not consistently beat naive baselines (EV05).
caveats_zh: 主办方报告；模型没有稳定地超过朴素基线（EV05）。

name: sci-Plex3 (used to train PRnet)
scale_reported_en: 649,340 cells from A549, K562 and MCF7 exposed to 188 compounds at four doses (10 nM to 10 uM), 24 h (DS15)
scale_reported_zh: 来自 A549、K562 和 MCF7 的 649,340 个细胞，暴露于 188 种化合物的四个剂量（10 nM 至 10 uM），24 h（DS15）
dose_time_axes_en: dose: four levels, 10 nM to 10 uM; time: 24 h
dose_time_axes_zh: 剂量：四个水平，10 nM 至 10 uM；时间：24 h
relevance_en: B track: single-cell chemical-perturbation data used alongside L1000
relevance_zh: B 轨道：与 L1000 并用的单细胞化学扰动数据
caveats_en: Also used to train PRnet (MD02); data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 也用于训练 PRnet（MD02）；数据获取途径未核查。

name: Perturbation panel profiling (P3) in iPSC-derived cardiomyocytes
scale_reported_en: perturbation panel in iPSC-derived cardiac myocytes; panel size not stated in the abstract (GD31)
scale_reported_zh: iPSC 来源心肌细胞中的扰动面板；摘要未给出面板规模（GD31）
perturbation_type_zh: NA（75 种条件；类型未取得）
relevance_en: B track: panel design precedent, but one genotype
relevance_zh: B 轨道：面板设计的先例，但只有一个基因型
caveats_en: Abstract-level source; panel size, donor background and data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 来源仅为摘要层面；面板规模、供体背景和数据获取途径未核查。

name: Yeast CRISPRi across 169 segregants
scale_reported_en: 169 segregants; 8,046 CRISPRi gRNAs on 1,721 genes; 460 genes with background-dependent effects; 234 interacting loci, 157 in four hubs (GD30)
scale_reported_zh: 169 个分离子；针对 1,721 个基因的 8,046 个 CRISPRi gRNA；460 个基因存在背景依赖效应；234 个互作位点，其中 157 个位于 4 个枢纽（GD30）
genotype_info_zh: 来自自然变异的分离子基因型
relevance_en: Design analogue for genotype-by-perturbation interaction; not human
relevance_zh: 基因型×扰动交互的设计类比；不是人类
caveats_en: Yeast with a fitness readout, not a transcriptome; transfer to human cells is untested.
caveats_zh: 酵母，读出是适应度而非转录组；向人类细胞的迁移未经检验。

name: Base-editing plus Perturb-seq of cancer drug-resistance variants (HT-29)
scale_reported_en: 11 cancer genes, 32,476 variants, ten drugs, four lines; Perturb-seq in HT-29: 27,823 cells (GD23)
scale_reported_zh: 11 个癌基因、32,476 个变异、10 种药物、4 个细胞系；HT-29 中的 Perturb-seq：27,823 个细胞（GD23）
perturbation_type_en: base-edited variants under dabrafenib or cetuximab
perturbation_type_zh: 在 dabrafenib 或 cetuximab 处理下的碱基编辑变异
genotype_info_en: engineered variants in one cell line (HT-29)
genotype_info_zh: 一个细胞系（HT-29）中的工程化变异
relevance_en: S track: variant-to-transcriptome readout under drug
relevance_zh: S 轨道：药物下变异到转录组的读出
caveats_en: Data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 数据获取途径未核查。

name: Perturb-seq of TP53 and KRAS coding variants
scale_reported_en: 200 TP53 and KRAS variants in over 300,000 lung cancer cells (GD26)
scale_reported_zh: 200 个 TP53 和 KRAS 变异，超过 300,000 个肺癌细胞（GD26）
perturbation_type_zh: 编码变异（递送方式未取得）
genotype_info_en: engineered coding variants in a lung cancer cell background
genotype_info_zh: 肺癌细胞背景中的工程化编码变异
relevance_en: S track: coding-variant readout at transcriptome level
relevance_zh: S 轨道：转录组层面的编码变异读出
caveats_en: Abstract-level source; no drug arm.
caveats_zh: 来源仅为摘要层面；没有药物组。

name: Parse 10 Million PBMC cytokine atlas
scale_reported_en: 9,697,974 cells; 18 cell types; 12 donors; 90 cytokines or PBS; 24 hours; about 7,400 cells per condition
scale_reported_zh: 9,697,974 个细胞；18 种细胞类型；12 名供体；90 种细胞因子或 PBS；24 小时；每个条件约 7,400 个细胞
genotype_info_en: 12 healthy donors; the page lists no genotype
genotype_info_zh: 12 名健康供体；页面没有列出基因型
relevance_en: G/B track: largest donor-by-perturbation single-cell grid; testbed for unseen-donor generalization and the mediation ablation
relevance_zh: G/B 轨道：最大的供体×扰动单细胞网格；未见供体泛化和中介消融的测试平台
caveats_en: CC BY-NC 4.0; commercial use needs a separate licence; the full h5ad is 41 GB; whether donors can be genotyped is unknown.
caveats_zh: CC BY-NC 4.0；商业使用需另行授权；完整 h5ad 为 41 GB；供体能否做基因分型未知。

name: OP3 PBMC chemical perturbation set (GSE279945)
modality_zh: PBMC 中的单细胞多模态谱
scale_reported_en: 146 small molecules, each dosed in triplicate across 3 donors (two male, one female) in PBMCs; baseline multiome of the same donors (DS17)
scale_reported_zh: PBMC 中的 146 种小分子，每种在 3 名供体（两男一女）中做三个重复；同一批供体的基线多组学（DS17）
genotype_info_zh: 仅有供体身份（3 名供体）
relevance_en: G/B track: small-donor, multi-cell-type chemical grid for unseen-cell-type tests
relevance_zh: G/B 轨道：供体数少、细胞类型多的化学网格，用于未见细胞类型的检验
caveats_en: 'Largest' is the submitters' claim; donor genotypes are not described in the record.
caveats_zh: “最大”是提交者自己的说法；记录没有描述供体基因型。

name: X-Atlas/Orion genome-wide Perturb-seq
modality_zh: 单细胞 Perturb-seq（固定–冷冻保存平台）
scale_reported_en: eight million HCT116 and HEK293T cells; 18,903 target genes; median 16,000 UMIs per cell; median knockdown 75.4% and 51.5%; median at least 140 cells per perturbation (DS24)
scale_reported_zh: 八百万个 HCT116 和 HEK293T 细胞；18,903 个靶基因；每个细胞中位 16,000 个 UMI；中位敲低 75.4% 和 51.5%；每个扰动中位至少 140 个细胞（DS24）
perturbation_type_en: genome-wide CRISPR targeting all human protein-coding genes
perturbation_type_zh: 靶向所有人类蛋白编码基因的全基因组 CRISPR
dose_time_axes_en: dose: graded knockdown efficiency; time: NA
dose_time_axes_zh: 剂量：梯度的敲低效率；时间：NA
relevance_en: B track: graded knockdown is the closest public proxy for hypomorphic alleles
relevance_zh: B 轨道：梯度敲低是亚效等位基因最接近的公开代理
caveats_en: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial); the preprint full text was not read (DS18).
caveats_zh: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0（非商业）；预印本全文未读（DS18）。

name: Genome-scale CRISPRi Perturb-seq in K562 and RPE1
scale_reported_en: more than 2.5 million cells; K562 covers all expressed genes and RPE1 essential genes; median knockdown 85.5% (K562) and 91.6% (RPE1) (DS19)
scale_reported_zh: 超过 2.5 百万（250 万）个细胞；K562 覆盖所有表达基因，RPE1 覆盖必需基因；中位敲低 85.5%（K562）和 91.6%（RPE1）（DS19）
relevance_en: B track: reference for pretraining gene-loss effects and calibrating effect sizes; stands in for loss-of-function variants when no drug is present
relevance_zh: B 轨道：用于预训练基因缺失效应并校准效应大小的参考；在没有药物时可代理功能缺失变异
caveats_en: Raw data on SRA; processed data location per the paper (DS19).
caveats_zh: 原始数据在 SRA；处理后数据的位置见论文（DS19）。

name: scPerturb harmonized collection
modality_zh: 单细胞扰动数据集（已协调）
scale_reported_en: 44 public datasets
scale_reported_zh: 44 个公开数据集
perturbation_type_en: varies by dataset; not itemized in the retrieved text
perturbation_type_zh: 因数据集而异；取回的文字中未逐项列出
relevance_en: B track: one entry point to many datasets and a distribution-level distance (E-distance) proposed for the interaction score
relevance_zh: B 轨道：许多数据集的统一入口，以及为交互项评分提出的分布层面距离（E-distance）
caveats_en: Data at scperturb.org and a Python package on PyPI (DS20); genotype information varies by dataset.
caveats_zh: 数据在 scperturb.org，Python 包在 PyPI（DS20）；基因型信息因数据集而异。

name: scNT-seq time-resolved single-cell RNA profiles
modality_zh: 带 4sU 代谢标记的单细胞 RNA-seq
scale_reported_en: about 55,000 mouse neurons; KCl stimulation for 15, 30, 60 and 120 min (DS21)
scale_reported_zh: 约 55,000 个小鼠神经元；KCl 刺激 15、30、60 和 120 分钟（DS21）
perturbation_type_en: brief versus sustained neuronal activation; a genetic perturbation in embryonic stem cells (as summarized)
perturbation_type_zh: 短暂与持续的神经元激活；胚胎干细胞中的一种遗传扰动（据摘要）
dose_time_axes_en: dose: NA; time: minutes versus hours of stimulation, new versus old RNA
dose_time_axes_zh: 剂量：NA；时间：数分钟与数小时的刺激，新 RNA 与旧 RNA
relevance_en: B track: the route found that identifies state-update dynamics from snapshots
relevance_zh: B 轨道：发现的、能从快照中识别状态更新动力学的途径
caveats_en: Method paper; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 方法论文；数据获取途径未核查。

name: Well-TEMP-seq time-resolved single-cell RNA profiles
modality_en: single-cell RNA-seq with metabolic labeling in microwells
modality_zh: 在微孔中带代谢标记的单细胞 RNA-seq
scale_reported_en: about 16,000 HCT116 cells after 0, 1, 2 or 3 days of 300 nM 5-AZA-CdR, with new and old RNA (DS22)
scale_reported_zh: 约 16,000 个 HCT116 细胞，经 0、1、2 或 3 天的 300 nM 5-AZA-CdR 处理，区分新旧 RNA（DS22）
perturbation_type_zh: 结直肠癌细胞中的 5-AZA-CdR（DNA 去甲基化药物）
dose_time_axes_zh: 剂量：300 nM；时间：0 至 3 天
relevance_en: B track: drug-exposure example of time-resolved scRNA-seq that could provide transition targets
relevance_zh: B 轨道：时间分辨 scRNA-seq 的药物暴露示例，可提供转移目标
caveats_en: Data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 数据获取途径未核查。

name: LabCompass loop data (Hugging Face)
modality_en: spectral flow cytometry (protein level), AnnData per loop
modality_zh: 光谱流式细胞术（蛋白水平），每轮一个 AnnData
scale_reported_en: spectral flow cytometry of in vitro haematopoietic cultures over loops 0 to 5 (eight stages including half-steps), about 60 GB; about 1.07 million unfiltered designed protocols; inference-only checkpoints per loop (DS23); the abstract reports 78 million cells (WM27)
scale_reported_zh: 体外造血培养物的光谱流式细胞术数据，涵盖 loop 0 至 5（含半步共八个阶段），约 60 GB；约 1.07 百万（107 万）个未过滤的设计方案；每轮的仅推理检查点（DS23）；摘要报告 78 百万（7,800 万）个细胞（WM27）
perturbation_type_en: cytokine and small-molecule protocols on primary human CD34+ cultures
perturbation_type_zh: 原代人 CD34+ 培养上的细胞因子和小分子方案
dose_time_axes_en: dose: continuous cytokine and small-molecule parameters; time: loop 0 to loop 5
dose_time_axes_zh: 剂量：连续的细胞因子和小分子参数；时间：loop 0 至 loop 5
relevance_en: B track: the only public closed-loop design data found, but protein level, so no transcriptomic analogue
relevance_zh: B 轨道：发现的唯一公开的闭环设计数据，但属于蛋白水平，因此没有转录组类似物
caveats_en: CC-BY-4.0; wet lab by the Göttgens lab per the card; protein-level readout and no genotype; the abstract's four loops against eight stages are unexplained (WM27, WM29).
caveats_zh: CC-BY-4.0；据卡片，湿实验由 Göttgens 实验室完成；蛋白水平读出且没有基因型；摘要的 4 轮与八个阶段之间的关系未得到解释（WM27、WM29）。

name: Response-eQTL cultures with nicotine, caffeine and ethanol
modality_zh: 干细胞衍生培养物的单细胞 RNA-seq
scale_reported_en: 51 Yoruba individuals; about 1.4 million cells; 31 to 110 response eQTLs per cell type; 380, 336 and 276 eGenes for ethanol, caffeine and nicotine (GD10)
scale_reported_zh: 51 名约鲁巴个体；约 1.4 百万（140 万）个细胞；每种细胞类型 31 至 110 个响应 eQTL；乙醇、咖啡因和尼古丁分别有 380、336 和 276 个 eGene（GD10）
genotype_info_zh: 有基因型（响应 eQTL 定位）
relevance_en: G track: genotype-by-treatment single-cell data at tens of individuals; the interaction is regulatory, sparse and cell-type specific
relevance_zh: G 轨道：数十个个体规模的基因型×处理单细胞数据；交互是调控性的、稀疏的、细胞类型特异的
caveats_en: A 2026 review gives 53 individuals; the preprint text reports 51; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 2026 年的一篇综述给出 53 名个体；预印本文本报告的是 51 名；数据获取途径未核查。

name: Influenza-exposed PBMCs from 90 individuals
modality_zh: 单细胞 RNA-seq 加 DNA 测序
scale_reported_en: PBMCs from European- and African-ancestry males, influenza A virus versus mock; the individual count was not verified from the abstract read (GD49)
scale_reported_zh: 来自欧洲祖源和非洲祖源男性的 PBMC，甲型流感病毒对照模拟处理；个体数未能从所读摘要核实（GD49）
relevance_en: G track: genotype-by-stimulus effects at single-cell resolution; cell-type specific and largely cis-regulatory
relevance_zh: G 轨道：单细胞分辨率的基因型×刺激效应；细胞类型特异且大部分为 cis 调控
caveats_en: Abstract-level source; the stimulus is a virus, not a drug; data access not checked.
caveats_zh: 来源仅为摘要层面；刺激物是病毒而不是药物；数据获取途径未核查。

name: Village-in-a-dish hiPSC lines (104-donor village)
modality_en: single-cell RNA-seq of pooled hiPSC lines demultiplexed by genotype
modality_zh: 按基因型解复用的混池 hiPSC 细胞系的单细胞 RNA-seq
scale_reported_en: villages of 3 and 18 hiPSC lines (88,927 and 29,055 cells after QC) (GD47); a village of neural progenitors from 44 donors (GD48)
scale_reported_zh: 3 个和 18 个 hiPSC 细胞系的村落（质控后 88,927 和 29,055 个细胞）（GD47）；来自 44 名供体的神经祖细胞村落（GD48）
perturbation_type_en: none reported in the retrieved text (culture design)
perturbation_type_zh: 取回的文字中未报告（培养设计）
genotype_info_zh: 对混池细胞系按基因型解复用
relevance_en: G track: low-cost route to donor-by-perturbation designs
relevance_zh: G 轨道：实现供体×扰动设计的低成本途径
caveats_en: Village status explained 0.22% of expression variance against 0.71% for line, but line proportions drifted and 5 of 18 lines were lost in 15 days (GD47); no drug arm.
caveats_zh: 村落状态解释了 0.22% 的表达方差，细胞系解释了 0.71%，但各系比例会漂移，18 个系中有 5 个在 15 天内丢失（GD47）；没有药物组。

name: MIX-Seq pooled cell lines
modality_en: single-cell RNA-seq of pooled cell lines demultiplexed by genotype
modality_zh: 按基因型解复用的混池细胞系的单细胞 RNA-seq
scale_reported_en: 24 to 99 SNP-demultiplexed lines in a pool, 13 drugs (GD45)
scale_reported_zh: 混池中 24 至 99 个按 SNP 解复用的细胞系，13 种药物（GD45）
perturbation_type_en: drug treatments (compounds not itemized in the retrieved text)
perturbation_type_zh: 药物处理（取回的文字中未逐一列出化合物）
genotype_info_zh: 按基因型解复用得到细胞系身份
relevance_en: S track: a variant switches a drug-induced programme off (TP53)
relevance_zh: S 轨道：变异把药物诱导的程序关闭（TP53）
caveats_en: Nutlin moved all 7 TP53 wild-type lines and little in 17 TP53-mutant lines (GD45); total pool size varies.
caveats_zh: Nutlin 使全部 7 个 TP53 野生型细胞系发生变化，而在 17 个 TP53 突变系中变化很小（GD45）；混池总规模不固定。

name: Isogenic chemical-genetic interaction map (51 cancer genes by 90 drugs)
scale_reported_en: 51 aberrant cancer genes; 90 drug responses (GD46)
scale_reported_zh: 51 个异常癌基因；90 种药物响应（GD46）
genotype_info_en: engineered isogenic cells carrying aberrant cancer genes
genotype_info_zh: 携带异常癌基因的工程化同基因细胞
relevance_en: S track: gene-variant-by-drug interaction labels without lineage confounding
relevance_zh: S 轨道：没有谱系混杂的基因变异×药物交互标签
caveats_en: Abstract-level source; cell background and readout unchecked; no transcriptome is reported in the abstract.
caveats_zh: 来源仅为摘要层面；细胞背景和读出未核对；摘要没有报告转录组。

name: Caffeine reporter-assay variants in vascular endothelial cells
modality_zh: 大规模并行报告基因实验（没有转录组）
scale_reported_en: over 43,000 variants designed; 665 SNPs with allelic effects (FDR below 10%, 30,680 tested); 6 conditional allele-specific effects under caffeine (FDR below 5%, 15,927 tested) (GD50)
scale_reported_zh: 设计了 43,000 多个变异；665 个 SNP 有等位基因效应（FDR 低于 10%，检测 30,680 个）；6 个在咖啡因下有条件性等位基因特异效应（FDR 低于 5%，检测 15,927 个）（GD50）
relevance_en: G track: direct count of regulatory-variant-by-drug interaction (about 1% of allelic variants at FDR below 5%, depending on version and threshold)
relevance_zh: G 轨道：对调控变异×药物交互的直接计数（FDR 低于 5% 时约占等位基因变异的 1%，取决于版本和阈值）
caveats_en: Reporter assay in HUVECs with one drug, not endogenous expression; the two counts use different FDR thresholds.
caveats_zh: 在 HUVEC 中用一种药物的报告基因实验，不是内源表达；两个计数使用不同的 FDR 阈值。

name: CRISPR-drug perturbational map (18 cell lines, 8 drugs)
modality_en: pooled CRISPR knockout screens with growth readout (no transcriptome)
modality_zh: 以生长为读出的混池 CRISPR 敲除筛选（没有转录组）
scale_reported_en: knockouts of 655 druggable genes in 18 cell lines (10 neuroblastoma) with 8 drugs; 94,320 combinations (GD53)
scale_reported_zh: 在 18 个细胞系（10 个神经母细胞瘤）中敲除 655 个可成药基因并用 8 种药物处理；94,320 个组合（GD53）
relevance_en: S track: labels for which pathway-gene losses sensitize to which drugs (a class-4 analogue)
relevance_zh: S 轨道：哪些通路基因缺失使细胞对哪些药物敏化的标签（类别 4 的类比）
caveats_en: Pooled growth readout (gRNA abundance); no transcriptome.
caveats_zh: 混池生长读出（gRNA 丰度）；没有转录组。
